title: Tech, policy and investment leaders from 120-plus countries converge on Dubai to drive clarity on AI's shifting priorities
summary: The organiser says GITEX GLOBAL 2026, the 46th edition, opens with the inaugural GITEX SUMMIT on 7 December at Dubai World Trade Centre, then moves to Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City Dubai, its new home, from 8 to 11 December, with Expand North Star from 8 to 10 December. It expects more than 6,000 exhibitors and 10,000-plus tech brands, with tech leaders, policymakers, investors and innovators from more than 120 countries, and bills it as the world's largest tech and AI event. Themes include AI sovereignty, regulation, the agentic economy and physical AI; showcases include GITEX Robotics & Mobility and GITEX Super Data Centre. AWS, Etisalat, G42, Google, Huawei, IBM, Lenovo, Microsoft and Oracle return with a larger presence.

title: Gitex Global 2026 to draw 6,000 exhibitors, participants from 120 countries
summary: WAM reports that Dubai will host the 46th edition of GITEX GLOBAL from 7 to 11 December, bringing together participants from more than 120 countries; according to the organiser, more than 6,000 exhibitors will be on show across 46 sold-out halls. The exhibition will address digital sovereignty, regulation, responsible deployment and intelligent infrastructure. Amazon Web Services, e&, G42, Google, Huawei, IBM, Lenovo, Microsoft and Oracle will showcase AI solutions.

title: GITEX GLOBAL 2026 adds a DWTC summit and moves its expo to Expo City
summary: A one-day summit opens GITEX GLOBAL 2026 on 7 December at Dubai World Trade Centre; the expo follows from 8 to 11 December at Dubai Exhibition Centre in Expo City Dubai. Headliners named by the organisers include Huawei, Microsoft, AWS and AMD; robotics, cybersecurity and data centres get their own showcases. TNW is a media partner of the event.
